subject: ACME Analytics — AWS listing language, CTA experiments & co-sell opt-in
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME AWS listing — hero copy + CTA experiments

Sarah — great to meet you on the call earlier. As promised, attaching the latest hero image and a short set of CTA variants we’d like to test on the AWS product page. High level asks:

- Help us confirm the one-liner that best maps to your buyer persona (data teams vs. platform engineering). We’ve drafted three variants in the doc.
- Confirm whether you want trial-based CTA (Start trial) or Demo-first (Request demo) as the primary action — field told us trial drives more conversion but demo helps enterprise scoping.
- Opt-in for co-sell: we’ll need your seller ID and the contact for the AWS partner manager to finalize listing visibility.

Attachments: rw_hero_v3.png, acme_pricing_table_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Kimberly/Marissa on the copy updates once you land on a variant.

—Michael
Senior GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
Cc: Diego Rivera <diego.rivera@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ACME AWS listing — hero copy + CTA experiments

Thanks Michael — attaching quick notes inline in the doc. Quick answers:

- One-liner: Variant B resonates most with our buyers (calls out low-latency inference at scale).
- CTA: We prefer Request demo as primary for now. Our sales ops wants trial gated behind basic contact capture to avoid noisy trials.
- Seller ID: ACME-SLR-9876 — I’ll loop our partner manager (Diego) to give you the AWS contact.

We reviewed the hero image — can you reduce the claims density (remove two bullets) and make the first bullet a benefit statement (cost per 1k tokens) instead of technical jargon?

—Sarah
VP Product, Acme Analytics
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ACME AWS listing — hero copy + CTA experiments

Forwarding Sarah’s preferences. Action items for the microsquad:

- Kimberly: revise hero one-liner to Variant B tone and reduce bullets to 2 — switch first bullet to a clear cost/benefit statement. See comments in linked doc.
- Marissa: update the product page flow to make Request demo the primary CTA; add the trial as a secondary CTA behind a light contact form. We need copy for field enablement that explains the trial gating.
- Sean: start the co-sell opt-in checklist — gather ACME seller ID, partner manager contact, and confirm regional entitlements for the co-sell badge. Also add DocuSign stub for the co-sell agreement.

Let’s aim for a draft we can run by ACME tomorrow (Thursday).

—Michael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME AWS listing — hero copy + CTA experiments

Attached updated copy in the doc (see ‘Field-ready flow’ section). Summary of changes:

- Hero: tightened headline to focus on predictable inference costs and 99ms median latency. Reduced bullets to two: (1) predictable cost per 1k tokens, (2) plug-and-play SDKs and AMI.
- CTAs: Primary = Request demo (leads to calendar + AE form). Secondary = Try free (light form + email verification).
- Field script: 3 quick talking points for the AE to use during demo discovery.

Notes: we should A/B test the Try free wording (Try free vs. Start trial) for top-of-funnel metrics. I added tracking tags to the doc.

Attachments updated: rw_hero_v3.png (annotated)

—Marissa
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Rivera <diego.rivera@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference>, Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: ACME AWS listing — hero copy + CTA experiments

Thanks team — confirmed AWS partner manager is Lisa Huang (lisa.huang@aws-partners.amazon.com). Seller ID ACME-SLR-9876 is active for the US region. I’m fine with Request demo primary and Try free secondary as long as the trial gating is clear.

Regarding co-sell, AWS asked for the following before they enable co-sell leads on the listing:

1) Completed partner opt-in form (I’ll send the PDF)
2) Evidence of field enablement (AE cheat sheet + demo recording)
3) Public pricing footprint (we can keep ranges but must include a baseline SKU)

We’ll turn around the partner opt-in and AWS contact info today. Diego (Acme) — I’ll upload the partner opt-in PDF and a short demo clip by EOD.

Forwarding to Michael: once we have the opt-in PDF, can we route to Legal for the DocuSign co-sell addendum? Also Kimberly/Marissa — please finalize the hero and AE script so we can hand the materials to AWS.

—Diego
Head of Partnerships, Acme Analytics
